Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity, quiet connection/map changes, bounded audio buffers, Turkish font and optional talking animation. 0.2.2 disables old default join/leave beeps once while preserving microphone and other settings. /yakin opens the panel.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R13)
Description: Optional mouse body + webcam scene free look, guarded native scene-angle hooks and bounded local head rendering through matching C+. Normal mouse mode remains available. Retains R12 projection verification, automatic hand preference and R11 mount crash recovery. New head look is on-foot only and requires native validation.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.
Changelog: Normal update: detailed face 0.2.8, Customize+ 2.2.1.9 and camera R13. Update all three and fully restart FFXIV. Live webcam, native mirror/sculpt and scene hooks still await in-game validation. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/detailed-face-mirror-camera-r13-testing-2026-10-21

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: Cooperative local NearFace retargeting with bounded lateral jaw motion and independent backward mouth-corner dimple expression. Existing Live mouth enables jaw tracking; lip detail enables corners, and cheek detail additionally enables a small matching cheek inset. Preserves previous detailed face improvements, saved C+ profiles, native hooks, ownership, eye calibration and head masking. Compatible with unchanged NearFace0.2.10. Native sculpt appearance remains unverified; no peer synchronization or new shortcuts.
Changelog: Normal update: lateral jaw tracking and independent left/right dimple expression through existing mouth/lip/cheek controls. NearFace0.2.10 is unchanged. No new profiles/shortcuts. Native visual validation pending. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/customizeplus-2.2.1.11-jaw-dimple-2026-10-22

Author: NearFace contributors
Name: NearFace (detailed face + small mirror)
Description: Local facial tracking with adaptive detail filtering, signed neutral gaze calibration and a compact character mirror. Matching Customize+2.2.1.10 improves separate inner/outer brow response, closed-lip jaw separation, blink-aware pupil direction and bounded combined cheek motion. Existing camera start and channel choices remain explicit. No response presets, new shortcuts, tongue tracking, pupil-size tracking or peer synchronization. Physical webcam and native sculpt appearance require validation.
Punchline: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
Changelog: Normal tracking update: adaptive detail filtering, signed gaze neutral, independent inner/outer brows, closed-lip jaw separation, blink-aware pupils and bounded combined cheeks. Update both NearFace0.2.10 and Customize+2.2.1.10. No profiles/new shortcuts. Native visual validation pending. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/nearface-0.2.10-tracking-detail-2026-10-22
